verdict.rationale: LiveKit ships an official CLI (verified to install and run), positions itself as built for coding agents, deploys agents to LiveKit Cloud, and supports outbound calls via SIP trunks. However, no evidence shows these pieces chained programmatically: creating the agent, attaching a phone number and placing a call via API, CLI or MCP without the dashboard. The MCP evidence covers only the agent consuming MCP tools, not provisioning. missing for 10: documented API/CLI commands for creating and deploying an agent, programmatic phone-number purchase or attachment, programmatic outbound call dispatch, a provisioning MCP server, hands-on corroboration of a dashboard-free end-to-end flow

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can provision a complete voice agent end to end — create the agent, attach a number, and place a call — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: LiveKit is built for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
Run your agent on LiveKit Cloud's global infrastructure.
Outbound trunks are used to place outgoing calls.
allowing your agent to make calls to or receive calls from phones
